memories.author: D01
memories.text: S: k/c/o T2DM x 6 yrs, HTN. c/o burning feet on walking; no hypoglycaemic symptoms. O: BP 138/88. O/E: monofilament sensation reduced at both great toes. A: T2DM, HbA1c 7.4%, suboptimal. HTN, near target. P: 1. Metformin (Glycomet) 500 mg BD. 2. Telmisartan (Telma) 40 mg OD. 3. Repeat HbA1c in 3 months. 4. Annual eye exam due. Adv: 30 min brisk walk 5 days a week; cut sugar in tea. R/V in 3 months.
